prior_analysis_not_evidence.title: 双边路后的中路补位
reasoning: Griff 与 Starr Nova 已承担边路和接触压力；敌方 Amber、Carl、Otis 现已还原，第三人需补矿区长线与携宝安全。
Byron 的治疗与远程压线、Janet 的探草及空中撤退、Pierce 的长线输出提供不同补位路径；必须检查 Otis 沉默与 Carl 接近是否能覆盖该角色的位置。
Gus、Shade、Rico 为已辨认禁用，另一个小 pin 未确认；不能推荐已知被 ban 的 Gus，也不能把未辨认禁用当作不存在。
rubric: 识别己方缺中路而非继续补边路
结合 Amber 清草、Carl 接近与 Otis 沉默解释射程和携宝安全取舍
说明首选如何与 Griff / Starr Nova 分工，并遵守已知 bans
prior_analysis_not_evidence.boundary: 敌方三人及第六手已确认；仍有一个禁用小 pin 未可靠命名，补丁和构筑未知。

prethin_builds.build: Bottomless Mags / Mission Swimpossible / Shield, Damage
changes_capabilities: Bottomless Mags 补一发弹药并创造弹壳，降低空弹期；冷却 22 秒，不能覆盖每次弹壳循环
Mission Swimpossible 让最后一发附带减速，提升中距离对线和防突进能力
Shield/Damage 让低血长手更能撑过第一波接近
poor_when: 敌方用召唤物、宠物或区域伤害干扰弹壳路线，或用刺客逼 Pierce 离开弹壳

prethin_builds.build: You Only Brawl Twice anti-aggro variant
changes_capabilities: 吸收弹壳转护盾并击退附近敌人，适合防一波强突进；冷却 18 秒且会消耗当前全部弹壳
poor_when: 弹壳太分散或 Pierce 需要持续弹药循环而不是一次性护盾

prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: 弹壳落在危险区，或敌方召唤物/范围技能让 Pierce 空弹

prethin_objectives.false_positive: 长射程不能替代矿区身体和探草
控制持球者不等于能进球，必须有射门/破门跟进
PLP Heist 信号要落到具体打库角度和弹壳回收路径
Pierce 在圈外打准不代表能持续计分
射程长不等于 Bounty 稳拿星；Dry Season / Shooting Star 的纯开放镜像里他常被更稳定弹道和更低资源成本的狙击手压过
Belle's Rock / New Horizons 的墙袋和侧路会暴露他空弹和低血窗口，Super 1 秒延迟也容易被有 peel 的对手离开

prior_analysis_not_evidence.title: 投掷＋保镖双选与拆墙反制

prethin_objectives.false_positive: Nita helps create windows but does not by herself solve closed goal geometry.

Nita's attack range is only 6 tiles and her mobility is low; on pure open Bounty maps she gets outranged before charging Super, so Bruce pressure only matters when walls, chokepoints, or bushes let her actually reach a grouped lane.

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

prior_analysis_not_evidence.title: 治疗吞吐与净化改变占区收益
reasoning: Lou 控制入口，Leon 有侧压；Poco 把现有两人的存活时间变成圈内收益
Da Capo 提供持续治疗，Protective Tunes 处理烧伤/控制，但都是范围、冷却和站位条件
Fang/Gray 的突进或 Amber 的持续压力仍可能在治疗窗口之外形成击杀
rubric: 把净化与治疗分别映射到威胁
命名 Da Capo 和 Protective Tunes
说明聚集吃治疗与被集火的取舍
prior_analysis_not_evidence.boundary: Da Capo 与 Protective Tunes 可由知识库校准；无原始补丁，不能把现版本 Buffie 数值套回视频。

prethin_builds.build: Protective Tunes / Da Capo / Shield, Damage
changes_capabilities: Protective Tunes creates a 3-tile-radius area for 4 seconds that cleanses all adverse effects and grants immunity while inside (cleanse reach 6 tiles); its Buffie increases the radius to 4 tiles and the duration to 6 seconds

Power Chord now constantly heals allies it hits for 400 Power 11, and Da Capo! adds 640 Power 11 more (1040 Power 11 per hit, ≈13% of max health), enabling tank or scorer sustain even before Super; its Buffie grants full-health teammates 3 seconds of 10% Super charge rate
Shield gear improves Poco's own survival; Damage gear helps convert low-damage chip when he is already safe
Medic's Melody Hypercharge keeps converting Encore overheal into a 5-second decaying shield; its Buffie widens main attacks to a 180-degree cone during Hypercharge
prethin_builds.best_when: team has a high-health frontliner, scorer, or zone body that can stay near Poco's heal lines
poor_when: team lacks damage and expects Poco to kill tanks or clear thrower pockets alone
enemy can split the team so Da Capo and Protective Tunes cannot cover multiple lanes

prethin_builds.build: Tuning Fork / Screeching Solo variants
changes_capabilities: Tuning Fork heals Poco and nearby allies for 1000 Power 11 three times (a 3-second buff healing 12.5% of max health per second in a 3.33-tile radius, not a persistent area); its Buffie gives allies inside the radius 3 seconds of 25% reload speed
Screeching Solo makes Super hit enemies for 1520 Power 11 without charging Super from that damage, keeping the low-damage finishing role; its Buffie silences Encore-hit enemies for 0.5 seconds
poor_when: enemy status effects are the main reason allies lose control, making Protective Tunes more valuable

prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: turn health resets into zone time and deny control effects that would normally force a retreat
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: team can group around a zone body and enemy pressure relies on slow, poison, stun, burn, mark, Frost, or silence effects
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy uses thrower pockets to split the formation, bursts through the heal window, or wins with raw anti-tank DPS

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Da Capo and Super keep a high-health carrier or scorer alive while Poco's wide attack chips and charges another heal
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: center grass fight, side bush push, or goal approach where a tank/scorer can stay in Poco's cone or Super line
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: escort a carry, keep push tempo after first contact, or reset a defender's burst before a scoring attempt
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: team has a frontliner/scorer and a real scoring-window creator
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: Poco is drafted without a damage carry, enemy knockback isolates the scorer, or the goal remains closed with no wallbreak/control

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Poco's wide piercing attack checks large bushes and charges Super against grouped enemies, while long Super heals through obstacles during retreat
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: bushy side lane, gem retreat grass, or Hot Zone grass edge where allies need safe movement through uncertain vision
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: protect carrier retreat, reveal flank pressure, or keep a zone ally alive while backing through cover
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: map rewards bush checking and the team can convert a revealed enemy with damage
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy outranges from open lines, burns grass first, or has enough burst to ignore repeated small heals

needs_teammate_support: enough team damage to punish enemies who walk through Poco's low damage
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Poco makes the push live longer; he does not create the goal opening by himself.

needs_teammate_support: tank/body or mid-range damage dealer who can stand on zone
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Healing a losing zone fight only delays defeat if the team cannot remove enemy area control.
Fandom mentions control modes such as Gem Grab for Protective Tunes, but PLP does not list Gem Grab as a main mode; use only as conditional support fit.

needs_teammate_support: lane pressure that lets Poco hold or approach the safe edge
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Healing does not convert into safe damage; Poco's low objective damage loses pure race matchups and PLP does not list Heist as a main mode.

prethin_objectives.false_positive: Wide spread pokes grouped targets, but low damage does not secure kills or stars on open Bounty lanes.

needs_teammate_support: damage carry who converts healed uptime into eliminations

prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: force gem carrier drop/retreat, remove a goalkeeper before a score, or stop a tank/scorer push for 8 seconds
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: the target must cross a known choke or objective route and Cordelius' team can hold the remaining 2v2 or convert after the isolation
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: Cordelius sends away the wrong target, his team collapses while he is absent, or the isolated target kites him until the timer ends

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Replanting crosses wall/water gates and Fandom notes Shadow Realm can move Cordelius unseen toward Heist safe or Hot Zone
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: safe barrier, water edge, central wall, or side route that normal walking cannot cross safely
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: turn a gated route into safe access, zone re-entry, or backline contact after isolating one defender
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: terrain is the main access cost and Cordelius still has enough health, ammo, or realm timer to threaten after crossing
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: crossing only lands him in short-range focus fire, objective damage is too low, or a thrower/control pocket covers the landing

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Trait rewards guarding contested standoffs and Super/Poison Mushroom punish enemies that must enter Cordelius radius
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: single-zone entrance, wall-adjacent zone edge, ball side lane, or close gem choke
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: deny the first body stepping onto zone, stop a dash scorer, or force a tank to retreat before objective contact
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: enemy plan depends on one close-range body entering a predictable route and Cordelius has Super or Poison Mushroom available
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy controls from outside his range, chains reveal/slow before entry, or baits the control tool with a low-value target

needs_teammate_support: lane pressure while Cordelius commits to isolation
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Heist value comes from route/defender disruption; if the map asks only for long-range safe DPS, Cordelius is a utility pick, not the race engine.

needs_teammate_support: scorer or wallbreak teammate to convert removed defender
damage after target exits Shadow Realm
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Removing one defender creates a score window only if the ball route and follow-up already exist.

needs_teammate_support: mid control while Cordelius leaves the normal map
teammate who can collect or guard dropped gems
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Shadow Realm can flip carrier tempo, but it can also leave his team exposed during the 2v2.

needs_teammate_support: wallbreak/dive answer if enemy controls pocket from outside Cordelius range
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Cordelius is an entry denial and isolation tool; he still needs someone to occupy the zone.

Bounty rewards low-risk star farming; on open maps like Dry Season or Shooting Star, Cordelius' short range and low health mean he cannot approach without cover, and Shadow Realm isolation leaves his team 2v2.
Knockout death is unrecoverable; Cordelius' Shadow Realm removes himself too, so if his team cannot win the 2v2 or if enemies outrange him on open maps like Flaring Phoenix, the isolation backfires.

Elimination rounds punish a lost entry; a missed first projectile leaves Stu without Super at the defensive moment.

prior_analysis_not_evidence.title: 抢劫首选的射线、百分比与资源角色
reasoning: Colt 能开线并持续打库；Colette 对特殊目标有强转化；Crow 的历史选项强调线权/反治疗，具体打库强度仍依版本
Kaboom Canyon 的中心草与长线要求同时解释守库与输出访问
首选的后两手要能补齐其命中、接近或防突短板
rubric: 逐个描述谁开线谁打库谁守库
承认 Crow 当前库的 race 定位有限
不把金库伤害数字脱离到达时间
prior_analysis_not_evidence.boundary: 历史候选集，不作为目前三大最强首选。

prethin_builds.build: Speedloader / Slick Boots / Shield, Damage
changes_capabilities: Speedloader adds slow and no-ammo peel/confirm tool
Slick Boots improves dodging, chasing and retreating
Damage gear increases punish when Colt is pressured but alive
poor_when: 地图非做不可职责是开关键墙或破门，且没有其他队友能开图

prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: straight side lane or safe lane where targets must move parallel to Colt

prethin_map_hooks.active_when: lane is open enough for tracking and enemy lacks immediate dive
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: target breaks line behind walls, stutter-steps unpredictably, or Colt must shoot through clutter

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Super or Silver Bullet opens goal walls, safe angles or thrower cover
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: goal mouth, safe-facing barrier, or thin wall protecting enemy pocket
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: creates scoring window, Heist firing lane, or anti-thrower angle
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: our comp benefits from the opened lane and can immediately use it
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: overbreaking gives enemy snipers/tanks easier access than our team

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Speedloader slows close targets and lets Colt land bullet streams

anti-dive protection at the zone edge

control or vision over central cover

changes_capabilities: Na-ah! 提供 0.5 秒 hypnotize，用于短暂拉近目标或打断路线；本身不造成伤害、消耗 ammo 且冷却 22 秒

prethin_builds.build: Instapoison / Carrion Crow / Shield, Damage
changes_capabilities: Instapoison cashes out poison damage and converts it into a decaying shield for a safer dive or escape
Carrion Crow raises dagger and poison damage against targets at or below 50% health
Shield and Damage gears offset low health and improve kill confirmation after chip
prethin_builds.best_when: team can bring targets below half and map gives Crow repeated safe tags or cleanup jumps
poor_when: enemy has longer range, spawnables, or wall pockets that stop Crow from tagging priority targets
team needs hard zone body, wallbreak, or primary objective damage

prethin_builds.build: Slowing Toxin / Extra Toxic variant
changes_capabilities: Slowing Toxin adds a 30% slow, extra poison, anti-heal, and with Buffie can bounce to nearby targets
Extra Toxic reduces poisoned enemy damage by 15%, improving team survival into high-damage or tank entries
prethin_builds.best_when: enemy draft relies on tanks, divers, healers, or grouped objective entries
poor_when: enemy is pure long-range poke that outranges Crow before he can tag

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: poison reveals bush targets, delays natural healing, and forces carriers to retreat earlier
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: Gem Grab side grass, center spiral bushes, open mid H bushes, or Hot Zone center bush mass
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: protect gem carrier retreat, reveal flank pressure, and stop hidden enemies from healing before a countdown or zone fight
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: map rewards bush scouting and Crow can tag enemies without overcommitting into thrower or sniper range
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: grass is burned, walls block repeated tags, or enemy outranges Crow on the route

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: poison halves healing, Extra Toxic lowers damage, and Slowing Toxin punishes the first body entering a grouped objective route
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: single-zone entrance, grass entry, wall-adjacent zone edge, or midfield ball fight
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: delay zone re-entry, reduce tank damage during a push, or create a teammate finish window on slowed targets
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: enemy plan needs healing, grouped entry, or close-range bodies to walk through a predictable lane, and allies can convert within the 3-tick poison / 4-second anti-heal window
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy controls from behind a wall, spreads across lanes, or Crow is forced to stand on zone as the main body

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Super can jump over defenders, self-pass in Brawl Ball, or land on a poisoned low-health target
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: midfield ball lane, side-bush scoring path, or exposed low-health backline after poke
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: turn chip damage into a kill, retrieve a self-pass, or bypass a short defender for a score attempt
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: target is below half, slowed, or isolated and Crow still has enough health or shield to survive landing
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy holds knockback/burst, target is behind multiple teammates, or goal geometry remains closed

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: long-range poison, slow, and anti-heal can win a lane and stop defenders from resetting
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: isolated lane, center grass approach, or safe-defense lane where Crow can repeatedly tag without crossing into burst range
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: convert lane chip into safe access for a DPS teammate or deny enemy short-range safe entry
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: team already has safe DPS and Crow's job is lane control, anti-heal, and anti-aggro defense
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: draft expects Crow to be the main safe damage source or enemy wins with longer range/cross-lane DPS

needs_teammate_support: durable carrier or mid control teammate
wallbreak/thrower answer if enemies hide behind pockets

needs_teammate_support: peel after Crow spends Super aggressively
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Crow can create or finish a score window; he does not solve closed goals or front-line holding by himself.

needs_teammate_support: lane winner that converts poisoned defenders into safe hits
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Heist Crow is a control/defense layer; drafting him as the sole race tool is a trap.

needs_teammate_support: area clear or wallbreak against pocket control
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Crow helps win the edge of the zone; he still needs teammates to occupy and clear the circle.

needs_teammate_support: teammate to hold star lead and convert poisoned targets
long-range or wallbreak answer if enemy has snipers or wall pockets
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Poison tags and reveal can farm low-risk stars, but Crow's 5600 HP and low burst make him a poor star holder when enemies outrange him on open maps like Dry Season.

needs_teammate_support: teammate burst or control to bring targets into Crow's cleanup window
anti-aggro peel if enemy divers can bypass poison range
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Crow can punish slowed or chipped targets, but Knockout deaths are permanent and his low health means a blind dive or open-lane trade against Belle's Rock snipers is a trap.

prior_analysis_not_evidence.title: 用不可忽视的目标路线绕过狙击对枪
reasoning: Angelo 擅长长线交换；Chuck 通过布站路线制造对金库的重复压力，改变对手必须处理的任务

prethin_builds.build: Spiders / Slimy / Shield, Damage, Vision
changes_capabilities: Spiders add bush scouting, single-target shot tanking, and temporary lane pressure

prethin_builds.best_when: map rewards carrier disarm, grass checking, zone entrance control, or stopping one high-value engage
poor_when: enemy has thrower/splash pressure that safely breaks spiders and cocoon

changes_capabilities: Personal Space cocoons Charlie and heals 50% of her maximum health, useful into aggressive comps

poor_when: the team needs spiders for bush scouting or shot tanking more than self-reset

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Cocoon forces Gem Grab carriers to drop gems, while spiders and Vision gear tax grass routes
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: center fort entrance, open mid with H bushes, or side grass countdown route
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: turn Super into gem drop, carrier reset, or countdown comeback window

prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: cocoon is broken by splash before follow-up, spiders are cleared for free, or Charlie lacks mid control after spending Super

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Cocoon disarms the ball carrier and can cancel incoming Supers; Charlie can also kick without consuming ammo
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: midfield grass fight, side-bush push, or goal-entry lane
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: stop a scorer, buy time for defenders to reset, or remove one defender before a scoring attempt
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: ball route is predictable and Charlie has teammate damage or scorer follow-up after the target exits Cocoon
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: team has no scoring window, cocoon breaks instantly, or enemy wallbreak/open-field DPS makes Charlie's low damage irrelevant

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Slimy slows entry routes, Spiders tax ammo, and Cocoon removes the first body stepping onto zone
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: single-zone entrance, L-wall support pocket edge, or grass entry near the zone
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: delay enemy entry, force ammo before a zone fight, or isolate the main zone body
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: zone fight is clustered around choke/grass entrances and Charlie's team can stand zone after the disarm
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy throwers control the wall pocket, splash clears spiders and cocoon, or Charlie remains outside zone with no body teammate

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Cocoon 暂时移除墙袋或侧草中的关键目标，Spiders 则探草、挡单发弹道并迫使长手先交弹药
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: 中央小墙窄口、两侧长草出口、出生墙袋前的 collapse 线
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: 把侧路线权转成短暂人数差，在毒圈前完成第一杀或迫使孤立后排离开保护位
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: 队友能在 Cocoon 期间压住另外两人，并在目标释放后补足击杀伤害；Spiders 不会被范围伤害免费清除
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: 敌方 splash 同时清蜘蛛和 Cocoon，Charlie 一方没有 follow-up，或毒圈前仍未建立侧路线权

needs_teammate_support: damage or body to collect dropped gems
thrower/splash answer if cocoon breaks too easily
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Cocoon creates the gem drop; it does not by itself secure the mine or the retreat.

needs_teammate_support: grass/side-lane control to keep Charlie's line available
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Stopping a carrier is not the same as creating a goal unless the team can convert the tempo.

needs_teammate_support: durable zone body or area clear
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Charlie delays and isolates; she needs a teammate who actually holds the zone.

needs_teammate_support: lane winner who can enter while defender is cocooned
prethin_objectives.false_positive: PLP lists Heist, but Charlie is a utility enabler there rather than a primary safe-damage pick.
Cocoon 只创造暂时人数差；队伍不能压住其余两人或补足释放后的伤害时，不等于获得首杀。

Charlie removes one target, but Bounty rewards low-risk star farming; her low damage and single-ammo cycle mean she cannot replace a real long-range anchor on open maps like Dry Season or Shooting Star.

Nita's attack range is only 6 tiles and her mobility is low; on pure open Bounty maps she gets outranged before charging Super, so Bruce pressure only matters when walls, chokepoints, or bushes let her actually reach a grouped lane.

Knockout deaths are permanent and Bruce can be burst down before value; if the enemy has splash/thrower/chain clear, Nita's Super feeds a pick instead of creating a catch window, so she is a late situational pick, not an open-map staple.

作者强调敌方难回答虚体，但 Max 的机动、Lily 的消失和 Rico 的留墙火力仍需逐项检视
Ruffs 若拆掉 Shade 需要的墙会自损；团队地形计划必须一致
rubric: 解释虚体窗口与具体路线收益
检查队友开墙是否冲突
说明充能与退出墙体时的风险

prethin_builds.build: Longarms / Hardened Hoodie / Shield, Damage
changes_capabilities: Longarms 下一发普攻 +50% 射程（3.67→5.33 格）并帮助从更远处安全充能 Super；Buffie 使强化攻击命中的敌人被拉向拥抱中心
Hardened Hoodie 虚体形态 30% 减伤；Buffie 使 Super 时长 +1 秒（6→7 秒）
Shield/Damage stabilizes short-range entry trades
poor_when: 地图开阔、墙体少，Longarms 仍不足以解决接近成本

prethin_builds.build: Jump Scare / Spooky Speedster chase variant
changes_capabilities: Jump Scare 短距跳跃（至多 4 格、可越墙，空中免伤），落地范围恐惧 1 秒：敌人逃跑、40% 减速且无法攻击/开 Super；Buffie 跳跃时获得 2000 护盾（Power 11，每 0.5 秒衰减 5%）
Spooky Speedster 中心命中 +20% 移速 2 秒；Buffie 命中后按当前冷却 -15% 缩短 Gadget 冷却
poor_when: 需要进场生存时，Hardened Hoodie 通常更稳

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Shade attacks through walls and can enter walls during Super
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: wall-adjacent pocket, Hot Zone wall, or Gem/Ball side wall
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: force thrower/control off wall, clear zone edge, or open scoring path
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: walls are intact and target cannot outrange or hit Shade through wall
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy is a thrower that still hits Shade, or Super ends in bad position

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Water trait, Super obstacle pass, and Jump Scare 越墙短跳 create unusual approach lines
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: water edge, wall-water gap, or obstacle route near objective
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: reach carrier/zone/safe route from an angle normal short-range heroes cannot use
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: route lets Shade start within threat range and still retreat before Super ends
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: route only moves Shade into open fire or short-range mirror

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Super lets Shade hide inside/through walls while pressuring nearby enemies; The Frightener 墙内每秒回 2000（Power 11）延长驻墙续航，Hardened Hoodie Buffie 再 +1 秒虚体
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: wall next to zone, gem mine, or ball lane
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: stall zone, threaten carrier, or deny defender position
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: enemy lacks through-wall answer and Shade tracks Super duration
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: enemy outranges through angle, throws over wall, or Super expires into enemy

prethin_objectives.false_positive: Wall pressure does not help if gem mine is open and Shade never gets Super
Shade can reach defenders but still needs a scoring route
Heist fit is route-dependent; short range can become a trap near enemy base
Shade cannot solo hold a zone if enemies can hit the wall anchor safely
Hideout/Layer Cake 的墙草图能用穿墙进场，但 Dry Season/Shooting Star 纯开阔无接近路线，Shade 早手会变成送星
Belle's Rock/Flaring Phoenix 的多角度和敌方 peel 会让 Super 结束时 Shade 卡在墙里或人群中；刺客反投掷不是无条件成立

notice: 以下来自当前实体源和既有题库分析，不属于被审计 index 的输入证据，不参与充分性判定。

prior_analysis_not_evidence.title: 双后排之后用身体防双突并保留主动性
reasoning: Gus＋Tick 已有远程与墙控，对方 Kit＋Mortis＋Angelo 会试图利用脆后排
Bull/Darryl 提供近距惩罚、身体挡位与反推进，让 Tick 有时间封路
仍需避免为了追 Angelo 耗尽保后排资源；Kit 增益与 Mortis 循环都要有终点处理
rubric: 识别反突任务而不是第三名长手
区分 Bull 近距守卫与 Darryl 滚动机动
解释护盾/治疗与前排的协同
prior_analysis_not_evidence.boundary: Cat→Kit、Daryl→Darryl 为语境校准；不扩展成所有近战都克 Mortis。

prethin_builds.build: T-Bone Missile / Berserker / Health + Damage
changes_capabilities: T-Bone Missile 让 Bull 进库或进草后多活一轮，适合 Heist 持续打库
Berserker 在低血时翻倍装填，打 safe 或近身 body 的窗口非常高
Health/Damage 服务前排承伤和低血爆发
enables: Hot Zone / Gem Grab 草口身体压迫
prethin_builds.best_when: 地图有金库屏障、草路、短入口或球门墙，敌方反坦资源不足
prethin_builds.poor_when: 地图开阔、敌方有 Maisie/Shelly/Colette/Lou/Otis/Surge 等稳定反制，或开墙会帮敌方长手
prethin_builds.bp_use: Heist access pick、Brawl Ball wallbreak/scorer、last-pick tank route punish

prethin_builds.build: Stomper / Tough Guy
changes_capabilities: Stomper 让冲锋不再必须全程走完，可停在目标旁边转贴脸击杀
Tough Guy 增强低血承伤，适合需要持续站住而不是纯 race 的局面
prethin_builds.best_when: 需要精确停在目标身边或地图容易让长距离冲锋送进危险区
prethin_builds.poor_when: Heist 主要任务是远距离冲到 safe，且敌方没有守库身体

prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: 金库屏障、斜草或侧路入库口，用 Super 破墙并贴库输出
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: 把一次蓄满 Super 转成高额 safe damage，同时开出队友打库线
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: 敌方缺守库击退/反坦，Bull 能接触 safe 至少数秒
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: Super 入口被控、safe 旁有 Shelly/Colette/Lou/Otis，或开墙反而让敌方远程 race 更快

prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: 球门墙、侧草推进线或中路球权，踢球后冲锋跟球
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: 打开球门或自传球制造直接得分窗口
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: 破墙后我方 scorer/远程更受益，敌方没有保留击退和硬控
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: Super 破坏己方关键墙、敌方开阔图更强，或 Bull 只击退敌方持球者帮对面开门

prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: 斜草、侧草或热区入口 chokepoint
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: 从草口逼退长手、守圈或迫使 gem carrier 后撤
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: 敌方缺探草/扫草，队友能跟随 Bull 的身体压迫
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: 草被清、入口被 slow/stun/anti-tank 覆盖，或 Bull 被迫横穿开阔区

prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: safe wall、球门墙、中心堡垒墙或 trick-shot 墙
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: 选择性破墙可打开目标；错误破墙会拆掉己方路线/掩体
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: 我方后续能利用开放线，且敌方不会因此获得更强远程
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: 开墙让敌方 marksman/scorer 接管，或移除 Bull 自己需要的接近墙

cannot_fulfill: 三路长线隔离中稳定守一路
needs_teammate_support: 防止敌方远程 race 反超
prethin_objectives.false_positive: 会冲锋不等于能打库；必须证明入库后能活并输出

cannot_fulfill: 无脑破墙后仍保证防守
needs_teammate_support: 控人/补射/远程接管开放线
prethin_objectives.false_positive: 破门收益必须大于帮敌方打开射门线的风险

can_fulfill: 反投掷/炮台的贴脸清点
cannot_fulfill: 被多重 slow/control 覆盖时单独进圈
prethin_objectives.false_positive: 站圈身体如果不能接近入口，只会给对面充资源

cannot_fulfill: 无视远程消耗穿越开阔中线
needs_teammate_support: 稳定 mid 和视野控制
prethin_objectives.false_positive: 高血量不等于适合拿宝石；Bull 更适合侧压和反切

can_fulfill: Super 冲锋逼退脆皮长手
cannot_fulfill: 无接近路线时的正面接触
对稳定远程 anchor 的持续压制

prethin_objectives.false_positive: Dry Season、Shooting Star 等极开阔 Bounty 图几乎不奖励短手；Bull 只在敌方三远程极脆且缺 peel 时作最后手惩罚，不是常规 Bounty 选角

can_fulfill: Super 破墙改变对位结构
needs_teammate_support: 长线压血、反投掷、开路前的线权
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Knockout 死亡不可恢复，Bull 的冲锋路径可读且不免伤；在没有草/墙接近路线或敌方保留反坦控制时，进场就是送头

prethin_builds.build: Tar Barrel / Steel Hoops / Shield, Damage
changes_capabilities: Tar Barrel adds a moving 2.33-tile slow aura around Darryl to secure contact after roll
Steel Hoops extends survivability after roll with 25% damage reduction for 2 seconds
Shield and Damage gears increase entry margin and close-range kill confirmation
prethin_builds.best_when: map provides wall, grass, water, or side route that lets Darryl roll into a high-value target without crossing full open range
poor_when: enemy has layered knockback, percent damage, hard control, or a tank mirror waiting at the landing
draft needs ranged safe DPS or wallbreak rather than entry pressure

prethin_builds.build: Recoiling Rotator / Rolling Reload variants
changes_capabilities: Recoiling Rotator sprays 15 shells around Darryl, scouts bushes, and can add Heist safe damage from point blank
Rolling Reload doubles reload speed for 5 seconds after Super, improving tank duels and safe burst
prethin_builds.best_when: Heist route reaches safe or a close tank duel is unavoidable after the roll
poor_when: survival after roll matters more than extra DPS

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Barrel Roll crosses water, bounces off walls, grants 50% damage reduction, and can be followed by point-blank shells or Recoiling Rotator
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: safe barrier, side grass entry, water edge, or safe-facing wall where roll reaches the vault
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: turn a lane win or roll charge into immediate safe damage and force defenders to hold close anti-tank tools
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: Darryl has Super, a route to safe, and teammates prevent defenders from camping the landing for free
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: open long-range lanes stop charge, enemy holds Colette/Shelly/Gale-style denial, or Darryl reaches safe without ammo

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: roll can bounce off walls, hit multiple times in confined areas, knock back targets, and enter with shield
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: Knockout side choke, checkered wall pocket edge, side water-bush route, or central cover corner
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: punish an exposed thrower/sniper/control pick after enemy peel is known and secure the first knockout
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: enemy lacks close peel or hard CC and the map offers a roll angle that ends in shotgun range
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: Darryl rolls through the target, lands in full-team control, or the wall pocket is protected by anti-tank burst

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Fandom notes Darryl can knock ball carriers loose, defend goal, and kick-forward plus roll twice to score
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: midfield ball race, side grass lane, goal-front pocket, or closed-lane scoring route
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: drop enemy ball, delay a scoring attempt, or cover distance for a two-roll score
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: ball route is predictable and enemy has no immediate counter near goal
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: goal remains closed with no wallbreak/control support, enemy holds knockback/silence, or Darryl rolls into stacked defenders

prethin_map_hooks.uses_feature_by: Darryl can use grass, walls, and water roll extension to shorten approach cost
prethin_map_hooks.route_or_position: center grass band, side bush lane, water gap, or lane split where walking short-range is punished
prethin_map_hooks.objective_conversion: convert hidden approach into lane win, safe entry, or defender displacement
prethin_map_hooks.active_when: grass/water actually ends in target contact and Darryl can leave after spending the roll
prethin_map_hooks.fails_if: vision clears grass, water crossing leaves him in open fire, or target can kite beyond shotgun density

needs_teammate_support: lane control until Super is ready
answer to anti-tank defender at landing
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Darryl is a route-to-safe burst pick; if he cannot touch safe, he is not a Heist DPS substitute.

needs_teammate_support: lane pressure or wall control to force target path
ban/answer to anti-tank CC if picked early
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Knockout Darryl is strongest after enemy peel is known; first-picking him invites hard anti-tank answers.

needs_teammate_support: wallbreak/scorer if goal geometry is closed
control teammate to stop counter-push after Darryl spends rolls
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Fandom supports Brawl Ball utility, but scoring depends on route and counter location rather than generic tank value.

needs_teammate_support: lane control until Darryl's Super is ready
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Darryl can roll into a carrier or mine fight, but shotgun range and auto-charge timing make him a poor stable carrier; on open gem maps he is a route-based engage pick, not a mine controller.

needs_teammate_support: ranged star-pressure teammate to hold open sightlines
forced path or control so the roll endpoint is not camped
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Bounty maps like Dry Season are extremely open; Darryl's short shotgun range and predictable roll landing let marksman kite and anti-tank answers camp him, so he is a high-risk late pick rather than a star source.

needs_teammate_support: zone body or area-clear teammate to accumulate zone time
range or thrower answer from outside the zone
prethin_objectives.false_positive: Darryl can roll into a zone for one contact, but he cannot hold zone time against lobbed or long-range pressure and his rolls are a spendable resource, so he is a route-based engage tool rather than a zone controller.
